async def load_user(conn: SyncDatabaseConnection, session_id: SessionId, txn: ReadTransaction) -> object | None:
    db_session = conn.session(session_id)
    user = await txn.select_one_async(UserRow, user_id)
    result = await db_session.read_async(lambda inner_txn: inner_txn.select_one(UserRow, user_id))
    return user or result
